messages:
marta_cs: Customer reports promo code 'WELCOME-2026' shows green check in web UI but org balance stays at $0.00. Org ID: org_67890. Happened after yesterday's billing account migration. Can someone triage?

devon_support: sorry to hear that. do we have the webhook/ledger logs? any error when trying to post the credit? also which environment (prod/us-east-1)?

marta_cs: prod/us-east-1. customer redeemed around 2026-03-14T16:22:11Z. Here's the callback line from the portal log: `2026-03-14T16:22:11Z INFO grant-service: promo accepted, grant_id=gr_9a2b, tenant=org_67890, amount=2000`

praveen_eng: pulled ledger ingestion logs for that grant_id. I see grant created but ledger service returned 409: `{"error":"billing_account_mismatch","detail":"tenant mapping points to billing_account BA_OLD which is inactive"}`. Looks like the migration changed tenant->billing_account mapping and our connector validated against the new active BA and rejected writes to BA_OLD.

marta_cs: so the portal shows accepted because grant-service created the grant, but ledger write failed. customer sees UI success and email but no usable credit. makes sense.

sasha_ops: quick repro steps I used: 1) create grant via portal API with tenant org_67890 + promo code -> grant created. 2) job `ledger-ingest` attempts POST /billing/BA_OLD/credits -> 409. attaching the snippet from k8s job: 
```
POST /billing/BA_OLD/credits 409 {"error":"billing_account_mismatch","msg":"billing_account BA_OLD not allowed for tenant org_67890"}
```

praveen_eng: root cause: after migration we didn't update grants-backfill mapping in grants-service. New tenants point to BA_NEW, grants-service still writes grant metadata including old_billing_account for a subset of orgs. ledger-ingest enforces mapping, so it refuses.

devon_support: what's the best mitigation to get customer credits now? manual ledger entry? requeueing won't help until mapping is fixed right?

praveen_eng: short-term: billing-infra can create a manual ledger entry to BA_NEW referencing gr_9a2b and mark grant consumed. I'll open an infra incident and include the grant_id + amount + timestamp. mid-term: push a small fix to grants-service to consult the latest tenant->billing-account mapping before emitting ledger events and add a retry/backfill for grants with mismatched BA.

marta_cs: I'll update the customer with ETA: manual entry within 2 hours, full fix and backfill by EOD. Also asked billing-infra to confirm once entry posted.

ledger-bot: incident-2147 created: billing-infra assigned to @priya_billing. Manual credit scheduled.

praveen_eng: added a one-off script to re-map 3 affected grants for the migration window; queued a backfill run for all grants created between 2026-03-14T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z. Will post status here when ledger write succeeds.

marta_cs: customer notified, they replied :thumbsup: and asked to confirm the new balance. will close when ledger entry shows up.

devon_support: followup: ledger-ingest now shows POST 200 for BA_NEW, ledger entry id le_44f2 created, balance updated to $20.00 (2000 credits). customer updated and happy. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
